svg.title: Agent visibility and optional local metadata flow
svg.desc: Observed OS relationships and opt-in provider metadata follow separate read-only paths into the desktop flow view. Authenticated typed routes dispatch source adapters, which share metadata validation before bounded session storage. Recording controls use trusted serialized native sessions independently of graph presentation. Reported trace parents produce call edges, while missing evidence remains unknown. The public browser uses labelled examples and no recording source grants action authority.
